chapters.title: Being Wrong Less
chapters.sourcePressure: Reducing avoidable error through unforced-error awareness, first-principles reasoning, antifragility, de-risking, and MVP testing.
chapters.coreMove: Turn a confident idea into a smaller reality test after rebuilding its assumptions from first principles.
chapters.commonMisread: Be cautious, avoid mistakes, and wait until you are certain.

chapters.title: Anything That Can Go Wrong, Will
chapters.sourcePressure: Plans can fail through Murphy’s Law, perverse incentives, cobra-effect backfire, short-termism, and market failure.
chapters.coreMove: Before launching a plan, trace what it rewards, how it can be gamed, and which delayed cost it hides.
chapters.commonMisread: Assume everything fails and become pessimistic.

chapters.title: Spend Your Time Wisely
chapters.sourcePressure: Time allocation is governed by compound interest, opportunity cost, and present bias.
chapters.coreMove: Protect a compounding use of time by naming the best displaced alternative and the near-term bribe that threatens it.
chapters.commonMisread: Pack the calendar with efficient habits.

chapters.title: Becoming One with Nature
chapters.sourcePressure: Systems change through environmental fit, slow momentum, tipping thresholds, and network reinforcement.
chapters.coreMove: Read whether a system needs adaptation, flywheel effort, a threshold push, or network density before judging progress.
chapters.commonMisread: Just go with the flow or wait for momentum.

chapters.title: Lies, Damned Lies, and Statistics
chapters.sourcePressure: Base-rate discipline keeps vivid cases and narrow frames from masquerading as statistical truth.
chapters.coreMove: Force a striking number to answer: compared with what usually happens, and what frame is missing?
chapters.commonMisread: Distrust all statistics or demand formulas.

chapters.title: Decisions, Decisions
chapters.sourcePressure: Decision trees tame complexity by splitting a hard choice into options, branches, outcomes, and visible uncertainty.
chapters.coreMove: Turn one heavy feeling into named branches with consequences and unresolved unknowns marked in place.
chapters.commonMisread: Draw boxes until the decision feels certain.

chapters.title: Dealing With Conflict
chapters.sourcePressure: Conflict is strategic interaction shaped by game theory, authority, incentives, and selective engagement.
chapters.coreMove: Read the response loop and legitimacy structure before deciding whether to press, reframe, give ground, or not play.
chapters.commonMisread: Win arguments by being more strategic than the other person.
